label: Natillas
note: In Spain a pouring custard of milk, sugar, vanilla, egg yolks and cinnamon, often with a María biscuit on top; in Colombia natilla has no eggs

about.text: A Spanish custard of milk and eggs, thinner than flan and without caramel.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: The eggs are mixed with a little cool milk first and stirred slowly into the warm milk. The custard thickens as the yolk proteins set; a few degrees too much and it splits. A water bath lowers the heat but can set it too soon.
